en: Colorized lithographic panoramic view of a town with fields and vineyards in the foreground and a dense settlement with church towers and factory chimneys in the distance. Caption at the bottom reads "Marburg a. d. Drau." with a handwritten dated message. The reverse is a German-language Correspondenzkarte addressed to Vienna, with postal cancellations from Marburg a/d Drau and Wien, a blue manuscript number, and a purple stamp of Univerzitetna Knjižnica Ljubljana.
